normal.name: Aaron Mahler
normal.text: Fired up Telarium’s Amazon - the 1984 Michael Crichton-written adventure game - on my #commodore64 yesterday. I have vague memories of playing it when I was a kid (on this very computer, in fact), but don’t recall how far I got. Based on yesterday, I assume not super far. :) It’s definitely a very unforgiving, tad buggy and incredibly slow loading game… to a degree I didn’t recall. Period glowing reviews certainly illustrate the evolution in expectations from games over time. #retrogaming

normal.name: The Retro Timer 💾
normal.text: Carmageddon (1997) was infamous for its violence, specifically for having players score points by running over pedestrians. And it's not uncommon to hear it mentioned today, perhaps as dark humour while stopping at a zebra crossing. By today's standards, the game is hardly violent, which makes it a must-play for anyone looking back at 90s gaming. For me, Carmageddon never really clicked. I'd lose track of the race, drive around running over pixelated sprites and get bored. #retrogaming #msdos
